nom: Urban Skin Rx Even Tone Super Glow Serum with 10% L-Ascorbic Acid + Kojic Acid

segments.oily: One reviewer describes her skin as ranging from oily to dry and reports instant results with no oily residue left behind.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or balanced-to-dry skin report good fading of dark spots but also note the product can be drying, especially around the eyes, and some experienced excessive dryness and peeling within the first week.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive report mixed outcomes: several describe stinging, itching, redness, breakouts or rosacea/eczema flare-ups, while others with sensitive skin still report brightening results once acclimated; some explicitly warn sensitive-skin users away from this serum.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s describes her skin as dry-to-balanced and 'mature,' reporting initial stinging and redness that resolved after a few uses, followed by visible improvement in dark spots and hyperpigmentation.
segments.combination: One reviewer with skin ranging from oily to dry (combination-like) reports seeing instant results when combining this serum with other products.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the serum for anti-aging or 'mature' skin report firmer, younger-looking skin and improved overall appearance; no dissent noted on this specific concern.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers report the serum or the surrounding product line left their skin excessively dry and peeling, particularly around the eyes; others report no dryness and describe good absorption without residue.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the serum caused new redness, stinging or irritation on first use, sometimes resolving with continued use; a board-certified dermatologist reviewer states the formula is designed to fight redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with rosacea and eczema report severe flare-ups after only two uses; one describes irritation and itching within minutes of application and immediate discontinuation.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers who mention dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, or sun spots report visible fading, sometimes within one to three weeks; two reviewers report the newer formula shows less brightening effect than earlier versions they had used.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer new blemishes and faster fading of old acne scars and marks with regular use; several dissent, reporting new breakouts, cystic-type bumps, or pimples after just a few days to a week of use, sometimes attributed to a recent formula change.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily-to-dry skin reports the serum absorbs without leaving oily residue; no other reviewers address oiliness specifically.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs well without residue once settled
Visible glow and brightening after use
Bottle underfilled or discolored on arrival

extraits.titre: Not for Sensitive Skin & Horrible Scent
extraits.texte: Let me start by saying that my skin is very sensitive, 48 years old, impacted with rosacea and additional intermittent eczema. That being said this product line is purported to be safe for sensitive reactive aged skin. Also let me say that the reaction I experienced with this product line was not retinol purging. I had been using IS Clinical Products for several years including their anti-aging retinol products. Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? If I hadn't had a hypersensitivity reaction to these products and even if they worked as marketed I wouldn't have repurchased any of these products because they smell horrible.

extraits.titre: I LOVE the Urban Skin product line
extraits.texte: I started with the cleansing bar when I received a free sample. I loved it so much that I decided to try the starter kit since Ive never had an actual skincare routine. The kit included the cleansing bar, super glow serum, daytime moisturizer, and dark spot cream. I used all for a week so far and all of a sudden my face is excessively dry and peeling like I have a sunburn. Did anyone else find this happen to them? I love how the serum gives an instant glow and I found it tingles a little but I do have sensitive skin and I'm wondering if its to harsh for me? After doing my research about the products, I didn't expect this dryness to occur. Anyone else experience this from the serum and/or creams? I know its not the cleansing bar because Ive been using that for a while now.

I am a board-certified dermatologist. This is my personal favorite vitamin C serum and the one that I recommend to my patients. This serum contains the exact same, highly-effective combination of ingredients as the gold-standard SkinCeuticals serum, at just a fraction of the cost. It also has additional ingredients that are proven to fight redness and pigmentation issues. Vitamin C is a very difficult product to formulate in a way that's effective and shelf stable. Unfortunately, all of the best serums that use the effective form of vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid) tend to feel tacky and have an unpleasant smell (for example, SkinCeuticals is known to smell like hotdog water)— obviously not ideal, but that's just a small price you pay in order to reap the benefits of a highly beneficial skincare ingredient. If a vitamin C serum doesn't feel slightly tacky or have an odd smell, it likely doesn't contain L-ascorbic acid and therefore, isn't formulated in a way that's effective, shelf stable, or leading to any long term benefit for your skin. As far as vitamin C serums go, I think the smell of this one is actually not bad..even somewhat pleasant. They've done a good job of masking the underlying "hotdog water" smell of all ascorbic acid-containing products. Yes, it goes on slightly tacky, but it eventually dries down and the tackiness goes away after a moisturizer is applied. It works well under my moisturizer, sunscreen, and makeup. I would normally wait at least 30 days before postimg a review for a skincare product. I have used this Vitamin C serum a total of 4 times and I am already seeing results and I am very impressed!! I have been using vit c for a few years and my regular one was discontinued some time ago, and I've been searching for a new one since. I finally found it with this!! I will say that I had to acclimate my skin to this one, not sure if it's because of the kojic acid that's in it, or if it's where I'm just starting to go through menopause and my skin is out of whack…. The first time I used I got some stinging and redness so I waited two days before using it again. Then after my second time using it I waited one day until i was up to every day. I do not use this on my eyes because its just too drying on that area, specifically my eye lids. But now my skin is loving it and I don't have any stinging or redness and I have seen a huge improvement with the dark spots on my cheeks and the hyperpigmentation on my forehead. The serum does get tacky after it soaks in, but by the time I've applied my Q10 serum and moisturizer and SPF, its fine. It isn't sticky to where I just can't stand it. My skin is dry to balanced and I'm in my 40s so I guess that's "mature' skin. I definitely recommend this if you need to fade dark spots and help with hyperpigmentation!
